name: Pig Boss
storyline:
You are an intern at a major medical firm. Today, you’ve been asked to stay for a night shift. Nothing unusual—except that this time, something is wrong.

The offices are empty. Strange sounds echo from locked laboratories. The security system has locked down the exits. And your boss seems not to have left his office for a long, long time.
summary: You’ve been called in for a night shift at a medical firm. The offices are empty, the doors are locked, and your boss is acting increasingly strange. Explore the building, uncover corporate secrets, and try to survive until morning. Your choices will determine who makes it out alive.
